name: Anthony J. Fidaleo
office: West Basin Municipal Water District, Member, Board of Directors, Division 1

items.text: Anthony J. Fidaleo is a CPA (inactive). He has been the chief executive officer of a financial consulting practice since 1992 and the chief financial officer of several public companies. He supports fiscal accountability, affordable rates, water recycling and conservation, and reducing reliance on imported water.
